missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative exclamation. 'Имя' stays in the nominative case as the subject of praise. 'Красивое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'какое' opens an exclamation.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Имя' is the accusative direct object of 'помню', identical to the nominative because the noun is neuter inanimate. The phrase admits forgetting.

missions.phrase: Я не знаю имени этого человека.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive case. 'Имени' is the irregular genitive of the -мя neuter noun, governed by the negated 'знаю'. Note the special '-ени' stem extension typical of this class.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Имени' is the irregular dative of имя after 'к', expressing getting used to it. 'Твоему' agrees in the dative, and the '-ени' extension recurs in the oblique forms.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Именем' is the irregular instrumental of имя, expressing the means of signing. 'Моим' agrees in the instrumental, showing whose name is used.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об имени' uses the irregular prepositional form 'имени' after 'о' to express what is debated. The '-ени' extension marks this -мя noun class.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Имена' is the irregular nominative plural of имя, with the stress shift and ending typical of -мя nouns. 'Редкие' agrees in the plural.

missions.phrase: Я записал все имена в тетрадь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Имена' is the accusative plural object of 'записал', identical to the nominative plural because the noun is inanimate. 'Все' quantifies them.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Имён' is the irregular genitive plural of имя, governed by the negated 'знает'. 'Наших' agrees in the genitive plural, and the form drops the stem extension.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of naming. 'Именем' is the instrumental of имя used with 'зовут' to express what someone is called. 'Редким' agrees in the instrumental, describing the rare name.
